compounds.name: Piperine
compounds.known_mechanism: Stimulates melanocyte proliferation and morphological dendrite extension; increases bioavailability of co-administered polyphenols

compounds.name: Baicalein
compounds.known_mechanism: Potent natural JAK1/STAT3 and 12-lipoxygenase inhibitor; suppresses IFN-gamma induced CXCL10 expression in keratinocytes and melanocytes
compounds.safety_profile: High safety margin, extensively used in traditional medicine

compounds.name: Ginkgolide B
compounds.known_mechanism: Arrests active vitiligo progression in clinical randomized trials; PAF antagonist and antioxidant; reduces cytotoxic T-cell infiltrates

compounds.name: Bakuchiol
compounds.known_mechanism: Non-phototoxic meroterpene from Babchi; stimulates MITF and tyrosinase without the severe phototoxicity/mutagenicity of classic psoralens

compounds.name: Thymoquinone
compounds.known_mechanism: Disperses melanin granules, prevents lipid peroxidation in melanocyte membranes, modulates CD4+/CD8+ T-cell ratios
compounds.safety_profile: Low toxicity, excellent oral and parenteral profile

compounds.name: Quercetin
compounds.known_mechanism: Protects against hydrogen peroxide (H2O2)-induced melanocyte apoptosis, activates Nrf2/HO-1 cascade and suppresses CXCL10

compounds.name: Curcumin
compounds.known_mechanism: Directly downregulates STAT1/STAT3 phosphorylation; prevents IFN-gamma signaling and mitigates ER stress in melanocytes
compounds.safety_profile: Excellent safety up to high oral doses

compounds.name: Apigenin
compounds.known_mechanism: Selectively inhibits JAK2/STAT1 cascade and restores regulatory T-cell (Treg) balance in autoimmune skin conditions

compounds.name: Resveratrol
compounds.known_mechanism: SIRT1 activator; rescues stressed melanocytes from oxidative death, downregulates autoimmune autoantigen presentation

compounds.name: Luteolin
compounds.known_mechanism: Inhibits IFN-gamma induced JAK-STAT1/3 phosphorylation, dampens chemokine secretion in epidermal microenvironment
